items.quote: when Moses went out unto the tabernacle
items.claim: Moses went out to the tabernacle.

items.quote: all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle
items.claim: When Moses went out to the tabernacle, all the people rose up, each stood at his tent door, and they watched Moses until he had gone into the tabernacle.
items.action: rose up, stood at tent doors, and looked after
items.mechanism: Moses going out to the tabernacle set it off: the people's standing and watching lasted 'until he was gone into the tabernacle'.
